changes.text: In fiscal 2026, the company acquired Arizona PPE and California PPE, expanding firefighting garment decontamination, inspection and repair services.
changes.evidence: On September 15, 2025, the Company acquired 100% of U.S.-based Arizona PPE Recon, Inc. ("Arizona PPE") for cash consideration of approximately $4.1 million.

changes.text: In fiscal 2025, the company acquired Jolly, LHD and Veridian, expanding its firefighter protective apparel, footwear and turnout gear businesses.
